semantic_insights: Current admission counts, historical snapshots and anticipated final scale are distinguished rather than combined into one asserted release size.
Imaging counts preserve their different units: images and admissions with radiology data.
The record explicitly limits the MIT license statement to the GitHub project and does not assign it to the dataset.
EEG extraction and the proposed holdout remain qualified as incomplete or unconfirmed.
Standardization claims are supported by named clinical standards and described mapping and validation workflows.
Funding attribution, award identifiers and creator affiliations are internally coherent.
